exposure: Use of oxytocin infusions in labor
cohort: All women who gave birth in Victoria, Australia between 2009 and 2013
finding: Numerous risk factors for severe PPH were identified, including multiple pregnancy, older maternal age, overweight/obesity, placental complications, macrosomia, instrumental vaginal birth, third and fourth degree perineal lacerations, in-labor cesarean section, birth at a gestation other than 37-41 weeks, duration of labor 12 to <24 h, and use of oxytocin infusions in labor.
mod_finding: Instrumental vaginal birth, in-labor cesarean section, and planned pre-labor cesarean section were associated with increased, increased, and reduced odds of severe PPH, respectively.
